The season started on 11 April and ended on 11 December 2021. [[Deportivo Táchira F.C.|Deportivo Táchira]] were the champions, winning their ninth league title by defeating [[Caracas F.C.|Caracas]] 4–2 on penalties following a 0–0 draw after extra time in the final.{{cite web |url=https://www.balonazos.com/deportivo-tachira-campeon-de-venezuela-2021/|title=Deportivo Táchira se tituló Campeón de Venezuela 2021 y sumó su novena estrella al escudo aurinegro|work=Balonazos|language=Spanish|date=11 December 2021|access-date=12 December 2021}} [[Deportivo La Guaira F.C.|Deportivo La Guaira]] were the defending champions, but they were eliminated in Fase Final A. ==Format changes== The league was expanded to 21 teams as relegation was suspended for the [[2020 Venezuelan Primera División season|previous season]] due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Venezuela|COVID-19 pandemic]]. The 21 teams were divided into three groups of seven teams each according to geographic location, with the teams playing the other teams in their group four times (twice at home and twice away) in a [[Round-robin tournament|round-robin format]]. The top four teams in each group advanced to the next stage, the top two to Fase Final A and the next two to Fase Final B. In both Hexagonals, the teams faced each other twice, with the champion being decided in Fase Final A. The teams of Fase Final A and the top two of Fase Final B qualified for international competitions.{{cite web |url=https://primicia.com.ve/deportes/la-temporada-2021-del-futbol-venezolano-comenzara-el-4-de-abril/|title=La temporada 2021 del fútbol venezolano comenzará el 4 de abril|work=Primicia|language=Spanish|date=3 February 2021|access-date=10 February 2021}} Originally, the two worst ranked teams among the last-placed teams would be relegated, and the other one would be involved in a play-off against the Segunda División runner-up to determine the final spot in the 2022 season. However, on 24 September 2021 the [[Venezuelan Football Federation|FVF]] announced that all three last-placed teams in the groups would be relegated, with only one promotion from the [[Venezuelan Segunda División|Segunda División]].{{cite web |url=http://www.federacionvenezolanadefutbol.org/consejo-directivo-emitio-resolucion-sobre-descensos-de-la-liga-futve/|title=Consejo Directivo emitió resolución sobre descensos de la Liga FUTVE|work=FVF|language=Spanish|date=24 September 2021|access-date=25 September 2021}} ==Teams== ===Stadia and locations=== {{Location map+ |Venezuela |float=right |width=375 |caption=Locations of the 2021 Primera División teams |places= {{Location map~ |Venezuela |lat=10.223449 |long=-68.011412 |label=
